about.text: Cream standardised to at least 10 % fat, usually 10–15 %, homogenised and UHT-treated or sterilised so that it keeps and stays smooth in hot coffee. Sold in Germany as Kaffeesahne.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Cream standardised to the fat of a coffee cream, then heat-treated; how hot decides how long it keeps, and the heat treatment must be named on the pack. Do not confuse it with Kondensmilch, which is sometimes colloquially called Kaffeesahne but is made from leaner milk and may not be sold as Sahne.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

facts.v: In Switzerland it is called Kaffeerahm, at 15 % fat
Not a defect; usually means no stabiliser in it
